evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ and modifies HTTP RPC server handling in src/httprpc.cpp and src/rpc/request.cpp.
rationale: Fixes spec-incompliant HTTP 400 responses and an Assume crash in debug builds on malformed JSON-RPC 2.0 requests. As noted in the description, 'the functional test in this PR actually crashes the node because the assumption is codified' when an authenticated JSON-RPC 2.0 request is malformed.
